name: Create identity token
description: Save a short-lived, audience-bound bearer for the caller's exact identity in its secret store. Supports identities beneath this venue's signing key DID, including agents. Grants no permissions; requires invoke on v/ops/auth/identity-token and secret/write on s/<name>. Agents use their owner's secret store. No private key or bearer is returned.

aud.description: Target venue DID; required, without path, query or fragment.

name.description: Secret name for the generated bearer.

lifetime.description: Validity in seconds. Refresh explicitly before expiry.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing secret when refreshing.

secret.description: Secret reference, s/<name>. Use with secret/use authority.
